title: Business-card site for a manicure master
lead: Services with prices, a gallery, reviews and three booking buttons, in a calm light style.
problem: A master needs a calm, light site: services with prices, 12-15 works, three booking buttons (Telegram, WhatsApp, phone call), address and schedule.
built: Services and prices in an expandable list.
Address with schedule and three booking buttons.
steps: The first screen gives a name and the booking buttons.
Services with prices open in a list.
A gallery and reviews build trust.
Address, schedule and three ways to book.
offer: A business-card site from your texts and photos.
Booking buttons set to your Telegram, WhatsApp and phone.
